Method of Attack: Credential harvesting via phishing landing pages camouflaged as Microsoft login forms
Embedded hyperlinks redirect victims to phishing pages
Harvest and send credentials to Yandex email accounts
Discoverer: IBM X-Force Incident Response and Intelligence Services (IRIS)
Impacted Systems: Executives' email accounts of German multinational corporations involved in PPE procurement
Partner environments of international companies in chemical manufacturing, aviation and transport, medical and pharmaceutical manufacturing, finance, oil and gas, and communications
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with embedded hyperlinks originating from a Russian IP address
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing landing pages mimicking Microsoft login forms
Yandex email accounts receiving stolen credentials
Russian IP address sending phishing messages
